dev.now: accounts, workspaces, members and MCP tokens, projects, boards and tasks — and now time tracking: the timer, timesheets, rates and reminders.
dev.next: Reports, budgets and invoices come next.
timer.paletteHint: Type what you are doing, then pick a project or task — or press Enter to start on free text.
timer.startBlank: Start a timer without a project
timer.shortcut: Press ⌘K or Ctrl+K to start a timer from anywhere
timer.archived: This project is archived — restore it to track time on it.
time.title: My time
time.hint: Your week, cut at midnight in the workspace timezone ({tz}).
time.hintOf: This member's week, cut at midnight in {tz}.
time.noTimeBody: Start the timer in the header, or add time for a day below.
time.addHint: Times are in {tz}. An end at or before the start is on the next day (23:00–01:00).
time.editHint: Times are in {tz}. Changing the project or the start takes a fresh rate snapshot.
time.deleteBody: It will be removed from the timesheet. This can't be undone.
time.locked: Locked — invoiced or approved, so it can't be changed
time.noPermission: Only members track time. Ask a workspace admin for the member role.
time.timesNeeded: Give a start and an end time.
time.stopFirst: The timer is running — stop it to set an end.
team.title: Team time
team.hint: Everyone's week, cut at midnight in {tz}.
team.noPermission: Team timesheets are for managers and up.
timeSettings.title: Time settings
timeSettings.hint: How days, weeks and totals are counted in this workspace, and what it charges by default.
timeSettings.timezoneHint: Days are cut at midnight in this timezone, for everyone in the workspace.
timeSettings.roundingHint: Applied to totals in timesheets and reports — never to the time that is stored.
timeSettings.currencyHint: Three letters (EGP, USD). Rates use it; existing entries keep the currency they were logged in.
timeSettings.languageHint: New projects get their default columns in this language.
timeSettings.defaultsHint: Used when neither the task, the project nor the member has a rate. Empty means none.
timeSettings.runningHours: Remind about a timer running longer than (hours)
timeSettings.daily: Remind people who track time when they have none by 18:00 on a workday
timeSettings.remindersHint: Reminders appear under the bell in the header. Email delivery isn't wired yet — it comes with notifications in a later phase.
timeSettings.readOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
rates.title: Rates
rates.hint: Hourly rates per member, from a date. A new entry copies the rate in force; entries already logged never change.
rates.billHint: Per hour, in {currency}: what clients are charged.
rates.costHint: Per hour, in {currency}: what this person costs.
rates.needOne: Give a bill rate, a cost rate, or both.
rates.defaultsHint: Bill {bill} · cost {cost} per hour when a member has no rate.
rates.noPermission: Rates are visible to managers and up.
rates.deleteBody: Entries already logged keep the rate they were created with.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.timer.long_running: Your timer has been running for {hours} hours
notify.timer.long_running.body: Still on it? Stop it, or fix the entry in your timesheet.
notify.time.missing_day.body: It's past 18:00 on {date} and your timesheet for today is empty.
